name: Plantain tree
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A wash drawing of a large plantain tree wuth two goats in the shade beneath. On the back are a pencil drawing of part of the A-Ma temple, Macau, and a drawing in pen and ink of a boatwoman at the tiller of a boat
